content:
sam_sales: Kicking off POC load run for Galaxy.ai — test plan below. Doing two runs: small-burst (spike to 200 rps for 60s) and steady-state (50 rps for 30m). Will use gpt-j-6B-quant / gpt-j-6B-fp16 as variants. Need quick answers on pricing for burst seconds and token caps.

maya: @sam_sales thanks — do we have the prompt size distribution? avg tokens per req?

sam_sales: avg 120 tokens request, 220 tokens response estimate. Peak tails up to 800 tokens occasionally.

rajan: For steady-state, set concurrency=20, batch-window=25ms. For spike, go to concurrency=100 and batch-window=10ms. Use KV cache warmup run 5m before measurements.

sophie: Noted. Security: customer requires egress IPs and SSO SAML metadata uploaded. Can we provide a short runtime manifest for VPC networking?

sam_sales: I'll attach docs later. For this run, it's hosted trial — they want throughput numbers before we share infra details.

deploy-bot: run-1929991111 started on pool-us-west-2 | variant=gpt-j-6B-quant | run_id=run-1929991111

sam_sales: First small-burst done. Quick metrics:
- p50 = 32ms
- p95 = 210ms
- p99 = 780ms
- avg tokens/sec = 14.2

maya: p99 spike during tail tokens — likely due to single-request 800 token outputs. Can we cap max_output_tokens to 400 for the next run to isolate model perf?

rajan: Agreed. Also check batching: there was a 200ms delay before kernel farm scheduling at ~t+23s. Sending logs:
```
[23s] scheduler: queued 120 reqs
[23.2s] kernel: selected cuda-ops v2
[23.4s] dispatch delay=210ms
```

sophie: On pricing: customer asked about burst pricing. Sam, can you confirm if we bill per-second burst or pro-rate to minute? They also asked about reserved capacity uplift for predictable tails.

sam_sales: I told them burst is billed per-second for hosted but suggest Dedicated for predictable tails — will put together cost compare. Rough calc: small-burst 60s at 200rps ~ 12k tokens -> ~$1.80 est for quant model. Need finance to confirm.

maya: Also a question for evaluation: run can be noisy due to network jitter. Propose repeating the small-burst 3x with 2m cool-down and median metrics.

sam_sales: Doing that now. Next run starts in 90s. Anyone want to add measurements to collect (e.g., kernel gpu_util, nvlink)?

rajan: gpu_util, queue_length, batch_size histogram, and host cpu wait times.

sophie: I'll draft a short answer to their security questionnaire about our network egress and SSO timeline while we wait.

sam_sales: Great. I'll post the final consolidated numbers + a short pricing note after the 3 runs. :thumbsup:
